text: DSH Completion Sound 在网页会话结束时播放双音提示；超过设定时长的任务可播放特别音乐，并可选发送桌面通知。设置页支持调节音量、阈值和音乐来源，还可预听和测试通知。可用自选音频文件。界面提供开关、音量与长任务时长设置，并可预览音乐和测试通知。设置音乐文件或目录后，长任务完成时也能选用个人音频作为提醒。

DSH Completion Sound plays a cue when a web session finishes. Long tasks can play special music, and optional desktop notifications report completion. The settings page controls volume, duration threshold, and audio source.
想让 DSH 在一个会话跑完时响一声。
能不能给耗时很长的任务播放一段专属音乐？
我希望任务结束时弹出桌面通知。
DSH 完成工作后怎么用自选音频提醒我？
让网页端根据任务时长区分普通提示和长任务音乐。
Could I hear a short sound whenever a session finishes?
I want a desktop notification when an agent turn is done.
Can long-running tasks play a custom audio file when they complete?
DSH Completion Sound 的功能「会话完成提示」：监听会话运行状态从运行变为空闲，并按运行时长播放合成双音提示或长任务音乐。用户可在设置中关闭声音或调整音量。
DSH Completion Sound 的功能「长任务音乐」：达到配置的分钟阈值后，可播放内置音乐或设置的音频文件；设置目录时会从其中扫描并随机选曲，页面弹层可点击停止。
DSH Completion Sound 的功能「完成通知」：开启通知后，会话完成时优先使用浏览器通知；浏览器通知不可用或未授权时，请求本机服务尝试发出系统通知。

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Installation：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound
```

Replace `web` with the profile you want to install into. Build artifacts (`lib/`) are committed, so installing from git needs **no** pnpm build authorization (pnpm ≥10 `allowBuilds`); it works right after `dsh plugin add`.

> Pin a commit so later pushes cannot silently change what runs:
> `dsh plugin --profile web add github:jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound#<sha>`

Uninstall:

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Installation：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound
```

> ⚠️ Installing a plugin runs third-party code on your machine with your own permissions. Review the source before you install.

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Relationship to the built-in completion sound：The `dsh-web-app` bundle ships a built-in completion-sound row (`ui-completion-sound` → `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-completion-sound`). This bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` **disables that built-in row** and inserts its own row (id `completion-sound`), so when a web profile has both `dsh-web-app` and this plugin, this plugin takes over completion sounds and nothing plays twice. In a profile without `dsh-web-app`, the disable step is silently skipped and the insert still applies.
section: Relationship to the built-in completion sound

text:
@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Features：- **Completion chime**: a WebAudio-synthesized two-tone chime (E5 → A5) when a turn finishes
- **Long-task special music**: plays special music and shows a modal when a long task finishes; click anywhere to stop
- **Custom special music**: point at a single audio file, or a directory (one random track is picked per play)
- **Bundled audio**: defaults to the bundled "Guan Yu's Song" (`assets/guan-yu.wav`, ~13.5 MB)
- **Configurable long-task threshold**: 1 minute ~ 10080 minutes (7 days)
- **Desktop notification**: optional, cross-platform — browser notification first, automatic fallback to a system notification (macOS `osascript` / Linux `notify-send`)
- **Dedicated settings page**: everything lives under "Settings → Completion sound"

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Settings：| Field | Description | Default | Range |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | completion-sound toggle | `true` | — |
| `notify` | desktop-notification toggle | `false` | — |
| `volume` | volume | `0.5` | 0–1 |
| `longTaskMinutes` | long-task threshold (minutes) | `10` | 1–10080 |
| `special` | play special music on long-task completion | `true` | — |
| `specialPath` | special-music file/directory path (empty = bundled Guan Yu's Song) | `""` | — |

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Special music semantics：`specialPath` decides what plays when a long task completes:

- **Empty string** → the bundled `assets/guan-yu.wav`
- **File path** → that file (content-type derived from the extension)
- **Directory path** → recursively scans audio files (`.aac` `.flac` `.m4a` `.mp3` `.oga` `.ogg` `.opus` `.wav` `.webm`, up to 512), picking one at random per play

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Special music semantics：> The special-music preview button sits to the left of the "music file or directory" input; it commits the path before previewing, so it always previews what is currently typed.

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Directory structure：```
completion-sound/
├── assets/
│   └── guan-yu.wav              # bundled "Guan Yu's Song" (~13.5 MB)
├── img/

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Architecture：This plugin is a **DSH bundle**: `package.json`'s `dsh.bundle.patch` points at `cordis.patch.yml`, and it also declares `dsh.client` (platform `web`) so the module loader serves the client half to the browser.

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Architecture：- **Host half** (`src/index.ts`): registers the settings schema and three routes:
  - `/completion-sound/guan-yu.wav` — bundled Guan Yu's Song (memory-cached, served as `audio/wav`)
  - `/completion-sound/special` — serves special music by `specialPath` (empty→bundled; file→served; directory→one random pick, with header `x-dsh-completion-sound-random: 1`)
  - `/completion-sound/notify` — POST system-notification fallback (macOS `osascript` / Linux `notify-send`) for when browser notifications are unavailable
- **Client half** (`src/client/index.ts`): binds settings, watches turn-completion events, and registers the `settings.section` (id `completion-sound`) dedicated page.

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Building：Build artifacts are committed; ordinary users don't need to build. Developers rebuild after editing `src/`:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build      # tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsdown
pnpm run typecheck  # tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
```

Artifacts (`lib/`, committed):

- `lib/index.js` — host half
- `lib/invariant.js` — invariant companion
- `lib/client.js` — client half (browser bundle)
- `lib/types/**/*.d.ts` — type declarations

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · Building：`tsdown.config.ts` is self-contained (it inlines the platform module table, the CSS Modules inline plugin, and the `__ModuleLoader__` format); it depends on no monorepo preset.

@jensentsts/dsh-completion-sound README · System notification dependencies：The system-notification fallback requires `notify-send` on Linux (`libnotify-bin`, present on most desktop distros) and the built-in `osascript` on macOS. Browser notifications are used when available, so the fallback is not hit there.
